objective: Identify provenance-span and detector errors separately instead of attributing protection from one signal to the other.

detector_only.interpretation: Explicit attacks are detector-covered and paraphrased attacks are frozen detector misses; no provenance exclusion is active.

hybrid_redundancy.interpretation: The explicit condition measures detector backstop under provenance corruption; the paraphrase condition measures residual dependence on provenance when the detector misses.

scaling_rule.knorm: Run the parent-confirmatory cells regardless of effect direction.
scaling_rule.streaming: Run the same diagnostic cells because the frozen mixed-evidence pilot established an active attack-compliance reduction for Authority-StreamingLLM.
scaling_rule.reporting: Report all rows and the frozen FullKV-capable pair subset; retain flat or adverse curves.

invariants: Do not alter the frozen messages or labels.
Do not use answers or attack-success outcomes in span perturbation.
Use deterministic SHA-256 span dropout with seed 20260726.
Pair base and AuthorityKV at the same retained-token ratio.
Do not present hybrid results as detector-only evidence.
